# M03 — Add, list and search

## Goal

`bm add`, `bm list` and `bm search` work on a fresh database.

**Why:** This is the MVP value. M04 (tags) and M06 (E2E) build on these commands and on the service.

**Satisfies:** D1, D2

## Scope

- `bm add <url> [--title <t>]`: canonicalise the URL, save it, print the ID
- `bm list`: all entries, newest first
- `bm search <text>`: search URL and title, case-insensitively
- error handling for invalid URL, duplicate and DB errors
- tests for service and CLI

## Out of scope

- tags (M04)
- export/import (M05)
- `--limit`, pagination, sort options (after the MVP)
- full-text index (not in V1)

## Acceptance

A1 WHEN `bm add https://example.com --title "Example"` is run, THEN the system SHALL canonicalise the URL, save it and print the new ID; exit 0.

A2 WHEN the same canonical URL is saved again (even written differently, e.g. uppercase letters in the host or a trailing slash), THEN the system SHALL print `URL already exists`, save nothing and return exit 2.

A3 WHEN `bm list` is run, THEN the system SHALL print all entries ordered by `created_at` descending, one line per entry with ID, URL and title; exit 0.

A4 WHEN `bm search <text>` is run, THEN the system SHALL print all entries whose URL or title contains the text as a substring, case-insensitively; with no match it SHALL print `No matches` and return exit 0.

A5 WHEN the URL is invalid (no scheme, no host, empty), THEN the system SHALL print `Invalid URL`, save nothing and return exit 2.

A6 WHEN the database cannot be opened, THEN the system SHALL print `Database unavailable` and return exit 1; the CLI must not show a traceback.

## Context pack

**Read exactly:**

- `ARCHITECTURE.md` (AD-1, AD-2, AD-4)
- `AGENTS.md`
- `STATUS.md`
- `docs/module-map.md`
- `docs/data-model.md` (table `bookmark`)
- `bm/store/repository.py` (API from M02)
- `bm/store/db.py` (connection/schema)
- `bm/config.py` (path to the DB)
- `tests/test_store.py` (test patterns)

**Do not read:** the briefs for M04–M06, `docs/quality.md` (only needed for M06), `bm/portability.py`.

**Budget:** ≤ 30,000 tokens input.

## Specifications

- **Layer/module:** logic (`bm/service.py`) plus CLI wiring (`bm/cli.py`); the store stays untouched.
- **Service API (M03):**
  - `add_bookmark(url: str, title: str | None) -> int`
  - `list_bookmarks() -> list[Bookmark]`
  - `search_bookmarks(text: str) -> list[Bookmark]`
  - `Bookmark` as a dataclass with `id`, `url`, `title`, `created_at`
- **URL canonicalisation:** `urllib.parse`; lowercase scheme and host; remove the default port; remove the trailing slash (except for the root `/`); query and fragment are kept.
- **Duplicate:** via `UNIQUE(url)` in the schema, catching `sqlite3.IntegrityError`; no prior lookup needed.
- **CLI:** Typer; output in English; exit codes as in the acceptance criteria. No domain logic in `cli.py`; only arguments, service call, output.
- **Title:** optional; without a title an empty string, not `NULL` in the DB.
- **Timestamp:** UTC ISO 8601, set in the service or repository (not in the CLI).
- **New files:** `bm/service.py`, `tests/test_service.py`
- **Changed files:** `bm/cli.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`
- **Reference:** `tests/test_store.py` and `bm/store/repository.py` from M02.

## Pitfalls

- `sqlite3` checks the `UNIQUE` constraint when the INSERT statement is executed and raises `IntegrityError` there; with deferred constraints, `commit` can raise as well. Handle both paths (verified with Python 3.12; docs: https://docs.python.org/3/library/sqlite3.html#sqlite3.IntegrityError).
- Typer: return exit codes via `typer.Exit(code=...)`, not `sys.exit` in the middle of the function.
- URL with spaces/user name/password: do not guess; treat it as invalid (V1).
- `datetime.utcnow()` is deprecated; use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.

## Edge cases

- URL with trailing slash and uppercase host → the same duplicate.
- `bm search ""` → `No matches`, exit 0.
- Title with non-ASCII characters (e.g. umlauts) → printed correctly as UTF-8.
- DB file in the wrong format → treated as a DB error; never overwrite the raw data.
- Very long URL (> 2000 characters) → `Invalid URL`, exit 2.

## Gates

1. `uv run ruff check .` → no errors
2. `uv run mypy bm` → no errors
3. `uv run pytest` → all green
4. `uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py -k "add or list or search"` → all green

**Visual check (not a gate):** on a fresh DB, `bm add https://Example.com/article/ --title "Test"` → ID 1; the same again → `URL already exists`, exit 2; `bm list` shows the canonical URL; `bm search test` finds the title; `bm search xyz` → `No matches`, exit 0.

## Limits

- **Scope:** only `bm/service.py`, `bm/cli.py`, `tests/test_service.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`
- **Stop:** max. 2 rework rounds; on a DB/schema change, stop and ask
- No architecture change; no new dependencies
